legacy_adapter_assumptions: Do not assume Body.children[0] is the recovered procedural trim/chassis group. Resolve exterior shadow casters explicitly by profile; native hierarchy order is not a contract.
The GLB uses KHR_materials_clearcoat and KHR_materials_transmission. Validate these in the actual Three.js GLTFLoader/material pipeline; native offline glass is not a browser-performance claim.
Do not call missing adults[seat].head/torso fields or construct fake capsules to satisfy the old CarAsset type. Keep the car-only viewer/profile separate until real occupants arrive.
Crack nodes/missing effects and runtime_visible extras need explicit adapter handling. Empty nodes are not rendered crack geometry.
Motion, wheel radius, brake/pedal rules, contact bookkeeping and game outcomes remain owned by the unchanged simulation, never by this asset.
